instruction: A candid wide-angle photograph from a slightly high angle showing an indoor studio with a red carpet and ceiling projector. On the left, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, touching the shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing away from the camera. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead lights.
elements: R2 is the person whose shoulder is touched by R1
R1 initiates the shoulder contact while R2 faces away
R1 faces toward R2 during the contact

questions.q: Is R1 touching R2's shoulder, rather than R2 touching R1's shoulder?
Is R2 the person receiving the shoulder touch from R1, rather than R1 receiving a shoulder touch from R2?
Does R1 make contact with R2 while R2 faces away from the camera, rather than R2 making contact with R1 while R1 faces away?
